snippet.title: [OUTDATED] Pre-Fortress 2 - Nail Gun Showcase
snippet.description:
"This is early footage of the viewmodel that we currently have and anything from the video could be changed in later builds."

This is a video showcasing the Nail Gun viewmodel in Pre-Fortress 2.

This was uploaded by your local nailgun addict and PF2 developer

Note:
This video no longer represents current state of the game. For an updated look please check out our New Grenade Showcase
